page.content:
The Ace who rebuilt New Japan after the dark 2000s.

How Hiroshi Tanahashi connects

  • Topic: NJPW — Tanahashi was the Ace who later became New Japan's president.
  • Character: Kazuchika Okada — Okada and Tanahashi's rivalry rebuilt New Japan's main event.
  • Item: IWGP World Heavyweight Championship — Tanahashi's Ace years were built on repeated IWGP heavyweight reigns.

What is Hiroshi Tanahashi?

Hiroshi Tanahashi is the Ace whose Rainmaker-era rivalries, multiple IWGP Heavyweight reigns, and later presidency pulled New Japan from decline into the Wrestle Kingdom boom.

Key threads lead to NJPW, Kazuchika Okada and IWGP World Heavyweight Championship.
